name: library-rotunda
about: The library composed like the owner's render 9 (2026-10-20: "create a scene like picture 9 with the stuff you have"; "it uses an extruded version of one of the circular vectors in our ornament library"): library-scene.blend's hall with its central tile replaced by a round ceiling – the vector library's ring-dial extruded as relief under it, a round window with a cross and a light in the middle (tools/rooms/blender/compose_rotunda.py). Scale 2.4 = the Cat Pope scan's size; the ceiling ≈ 3.4 m. The view: low, looking up at the ring (render 9). The map's places `library` / `monastery` (ch3).
